assessor_script: SETUP: Prepare assessment materials. Ensure student has clean copy of passage.
SAY TO STUDENT: 'I'm going to ask you to read this passage aloud. Read it as accurately and smoothly as you can. If you come to a word you don't know, I'll tell it to you. Do you have any questions?'
• Start timer when student begins reading
• Mark errors on assessor copy in real-time
• Stop at 60 seconds and mark last word read
interface_spec.student_prompt: Read this passage aloud as accurately and smoothly as you can.
interface_spec.student_action: Student reads the passage aloud from a clean copy. Student attempts to read as accurately and smoothly as possible within the 60-second time limit.
interface_spec.assessor_grading: Assessor marks errors in real-time on assessor copy. Calculate WCPM = (Words Read - Errors) and Accuracy = (Words Read - Errors) / Words Read × 100. Score prosody using 1-4 scale.
